indicators.label: Loudness drift
indicators.evidence: Recent RMS energy centers around 0.439 with a median of 0.419.
indicators.why_it_matters: A catalog can look fuller than it is when amplitude keeps rising while variation stays flat.
indicators.suggested_action: Compare mastering posture across splits before treating engagement changes as audience preference.

indicators.label: Language-share drift
indicators.evidence: instrumental currently accounts for 72.7% of the declared coverage.
indicators.why_it_matters: A multilingual lane narrows quietly when one language becomes the default source of comparison.
indicators.suggested_action: Add balanced language coverage to the next manifest pass and keep language visible in benchmarking.

indicators.label: Genre imbalance
indicators.evidence: signal-study currently accounts for 50.0% of the declared coverage.
indicators.why_it_matters: Genre imbalance turns discovery metrics into a reflection of catalog posture rather than listener breadth.
indicators.suggested_action: Widen manifest intake with smaller or regionally distinct genres before the warehouse calcifies.

indicators.label: Instrumentation collapse
indicators.evidence: B currently accounts for 72.2% of the declared coverage.
indicators.why_it_matters: When tonal color compresses too tightly, rich arrangement differences start reading like the same idea repeated.
indicators.suggested_action: Audit spectral diversity and pitch-class spread before clustering tracks into one sonic neighborhood.

indicators.label: Repetition inflation
indicators.evidence: Mean repetition ratio across the recent lane is 0.987.
indicators.why_it_matters: Loops are not inherently bad, but unchecked repetition can make the model overvalue familiarity.
indicators.suggested_action: Keep loop-heavy segments in view and compare them against more developmental sections.

indicators.label: Silence-padding abuse
indicators.evidence: Silence share sits at 0.029 across recent segments.
indicators.why_it_matters: Padding can make a source look longer, calmer, or cleaner than the useful content inside it.
indicators.suggested_action: Mark silence-heavy segments for direct review before they influence benchmark timing.

indicators.label: Production-polish bias
indicators.evidence: Median dynamic range in the recent lane is 0.615.
indicators.why_it_matters: Highly polished tracks can dominate if the system learns compression sheen instead of musical difference.
indicators.suggested_action: Compare dynamic range distributions across sources and keep looser recordings present in evaluation.

indicators.label: Regional undercoverage
indicators.evidence: global currently accounts for 72.7% of the declared coverage.
indicators.why_it_matters: Regional absence is not neutral; it changes which accents, scenes, and production habits ever become visible.
indicators.suggested_action: Add more regional manifests before treating the warehouse as culturally representative.
